description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Mphasis is hiring a Delivery Module Lead to oversee software project delivery, ensuring projects meet timelines, scope, and quality standards. The role guides technical decisions using Java knowledge and coordinates teams, project plans, risk management, stakeholder updates, and continuous process improvement.
Software Delivery Manager leading Java projects, schedules, risks, and stakeholder execution

Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage the delivery of software projects, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, QA, and operations, to ensure seamless project execution
• Utilize strong Java knowledge to guide technical discussions and decisions throughout the project lifecycle
• Develop and maintain project plans, including scope, schedule, and resource allocation
• Identify and mitigate risks that may impact project delivery
• Facilitate regular project status meetings and provide updates to stakeholders
• Ensure compliance with organizational processes and methodologies
• Mentor and support team members in their professional development
• Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency within the delivery framework

Requirements:
• Strong proficiency in Java programming and related technologies
• Proven experience in project management methodologies and frameworks
• Excellent leadership and team management skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Effective communication skills, both verbal and written
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and deliver results

Preferred:
• Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies
• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Trello, or similar
• Knowledge of cloud technologies and deployment strategies
• Understanding of DevOps practices and tools
• Experience in stakeholder management and client interactions
• Relevant certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master) are a plus
